claims.wording: The cohort included 4,468,509 US veterans who served during the Vietnam War era.
claims.source: Scott GD, Lim MM, Elliott JE, Neilson LE. JAMA Neurology. 2026. doi:10.1001/jamaneurol.2026.4219
limitations: Electronic health record cohort, not a randomized or exposure-measured trial
Records span January 1, 1999, to December 30, 2022; mean follow-up 12.5 years (SD 7.0)
Cohort was 98% male; mean age 60.6 years
1,035,210 participants (23.2%) reported exposure; 7,600 were classified as direct or occupationally exposed
claims.visual: Cohort description in the evidence section

claims.wording: The abstract says cumulative-incidence analyses accounted for competing risk of death, age, traumatic brain injury, and frailty; listed baseline characteristics were balanced between exposure groups.
claims.source: Scott GD, Lim MM, Elliott JE, Neilson LE. JAMA Neurology. 2026. doi:10.1001/jamaneurol.2026.4219
limitations: The abstract does not enumerate model diagnostics or provide enough detail to reproduce the adjusted model
claims.visual: Cohort methods and limitations in the evidence section
claims.review: verified against the primary article abstract only

claims.wording: Self-reported Agent Orange exposure was associated with Parkinson disease diagnosis (adjusted HR 1.44, 95% CI 1.37-1.52).
claims.source: Scott GD, Lim MM, Elliott JE, Neilson LE. JAMA Neurology. 2026. doi:10.1001/jamaneurol.2026.4219
claims.visual: Adjusted hazard ratio with confidence interval

claims.wording: Direct or occupational exposure subgroup adjusted HR 1.99 (95% CI 1.71-2.32).
claims.source: Scott GD, Lim MM, Elliott JE, Neilson LE. JAMA Neurology. 2026. doi:10.1001/jamaneurol.2026.4219
claims.visual: Separate subgroup estimate with confidence interval

claims.wording: Agent Orange was a formulation of 2,4-D and 2,4,5-T. TCDD was a contaminant associated with 2,4,5-T manufacture.
claims.source: US Environmental Protection Agency; PubChem CID 1486, 1480, 15625
limitations: TCDD is distinguished from the herbicide ingredients
claims.review: verified against EPA and PubChem records

claims.wording: Operation Ranch Hand used modified C-123 aircraft to spray Agent Orange; the opening visual is an illustrative C-123 Provider-inspired schematic, not a specific aircraft or mission reconstruction.
claims.source: National Museum of the United States Air Force, Down in the Weeds: Ranch Hand
claims.classification: historical aircraft record plus illustrative reconstruction
limitations: Procedural aircraft is a schematic, not a specific tail number
No specific spraying mission, location, or route is depicted
Terrain and spray plume are illustrative
claims.review: aircraft type and Ranch Hand use verified against the National Museum of the US Air Force exhibit record; visual remains explicitly schematic

claims.wording: Interactive putamen, caudate, and substantia nigra pars compacta surfaces are derived from the CIT168 1 mm MNI template label map; the dopamine pathway remains schematic.
claims.source: Pauli WM, Nili AN, Tyszka JM. Scientific Data. 2018. doi:10.1038/sdata.2018.63; OSF items 2qswg and 6qrcb
limitations: Not an individual scan or histology
claims.review: source mapping and affine checked; derived Blender and GLB assets generated; browser route and region-selection controls visually inspected; displayed atlas surfaces inspected; display smoothing and atlas scope documented

claims.wording: The interactive whole-brain reference uses the Allen Human Reference Atlas 3D brain model, mirrored to form a whole brain, resized for the Visible Human body, and simplified for browser display.
claims.source: Human Reference Atlas, Brain Male v1.3, NIH 3D entry 3DPX-020960
limitations: Generic reference anatomy, not a veteran or patient scan
Not an Agent Orange finding or exposure-specific pathology
Mirrored hemisphere; resized for the Visible Human body
Each of 283 named meshes was display-simplified with Blender Decimate ratio 0.5; not for diagnostic use
Kept separate from CIT168 because cross-atlas registration was not verified
claims.review: NIH entry and CC BY 4.0 license checked; optimized GLB signature, 283 mesh objects, 326452 Blender triangle equivalents, checksum, Blender import, browser rendering, and selection switching verified

claims.wording: 44 million pounds of 2,4-D are applied annually in the United States and this is four times paraquat use.
limitations: Source year, use categories, and underlying dataset not established
